claims.text: AC 107-2A states, if the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.

text: FAA guidance claims: AC 107-2A instructs reestablishing the control link or following loss-of-control procedures, and to land, hover, or execute a return-to-home sequence if VLOS cannot be regained. Manuals claims: for Matrice 30T, loss of signal can trigger RTH, land, or hover; RTH may be Advanced RTH or Original Route RTH under lighting or vision constraints; a disconnected icon appears, and reconnection does not restore prior control. For Matrice 4T, failsafe RTH occurs if signal is lost when set to RTH, with Pilot 2 displaying the pre-loss RTH path and continued RTH if the signal returns; Original Route RTH can occur under poor lighting/vision.
